Inspector sahab! Tonight at
twelve, come to the godown.

Eight hundred sacks
are going out.

cues.speaker: bhaiyaji

under your outpost.

this thana isn't in his pay.

complaint files taken too.

sahab phoned Bhaiyaji.

I need a raid on
the godown tonight.

cues.speaker: nandini
cues.text:
I heard Bhaiyaji's own voice,
DSP sahab.

cues.speaker: dsp

We don't raid on what's heard
over a fake thana's phone,

cues.speaker: dsp
cues.text: Put him in the lockup. Now.

cues.speaker: dsp

Any officer who helps him
will be named in the same FIR.

cues.speaker: nandini

But then the SHO
stamps the slip,

cues.speaker: nandini

and I can't stop a truck
that carries his stamp.

cues.speaker: nandini
cues.text: only he can get into the godown,

cues.speaker: nandini
